text: The ghost of Carno supposedly haunts the place.
It's not even supposed to be safe to live there.
Well, has anybody ever been hurt?
I don't remember any deaths, but plenty of injuries.
Over the years, the people who owned the place used to bring
workmen in to fix things up.
But invariably, some bizarre accident would occur.
One man had his arm chopped off.
Another man tumbled down a flight of stairs and broke his neck.
